resources.name: Seesaw

resources.name: Hoverstat.es
resources.description: An archive of alternative web design, with short observations on distinctive interactions and layouts.

resources.name: Antoine Wodniack
resources.creator: Antoine Wodniack
resources.description: A creative developer’s website exploring animation and interactive web experiences.
resources.relevance: Antoine Wodniack is a France-based creative developer and freelancer who specializes in animation and interactive design, often collaborating with agencies and designers. He co-founded Waaark and incredibles.dev, has worked on over 140 projects, and has won 16 Awwwards Site of the Day awards.
